rows.notes: [T080] start_year 2021 (v1 reported -> confirmed): Cailian 2022-07-20 (S2), quoting Yibin Sanjiang New Area: Sichuan Times phase 1 'formally put into operation' in June 2021. Steps (design/built-capacity basis): 2021 = 15 (S1 electrive 2021-06-21: completed first section, 15 GWh/yr). 2023 = 180: Yicai (S3, published 2024-09-14) says Yibin 'built' 180 GWh power-battery capacity in full-year 2023; Cover News 2024-08-19 (S4) repeats 180 built with 7 CATL factories running (Sichuan Times phases 1,2,3,5,6,7 + Times-Geely). CAVEAT: the 180 is a Yibin-city industry figure (CATL is by far the main producer; the T002 row already used it for the CATL base) and S3 is a 2024 article describing 2023, so the 2023 step basis is government 'built capacity'. 2025 = 210 and 2026 = 270 are the EXISTING T002 steps (solarbe 2025-11-14; mrjjxw 2026-08-19), unchanged. No 2022 step: the v1 timeline value 125 GWh (21jingji 2022-12-30) was not found on the page I opened (the page only has a 2022 forecast of 70 GWh and 235 GWh signed), so it is dropped. S3 and S4 were read through the fetch tool's extraction; auditor please string-match.

[T080] capacity_by_year_json (previously null), basis company/press 'built' capacity. 2021 = 28.5: Yicai Global 2021-11-05 (S5) 'current 28.5GWh' of the 152.61 GWh Jingmen plan (matches the EVE Nov-2021 announcement: 86.11bn yuan invested, 28.5 GWh built). 2025 = 169: The Paper 2025-07-30 (S7), 18 factories, same figure already used as installed. 2023 = 101.5 is MY SUM of two sourced figures, not a stated total: 28.5 (S5, Nov 2021) + 73 GWh in zones 6-9 'put into production' at the 2023-02-01 ceremony (S6); any capacity added in 2022 or other zones in 2023 is not captured, and the page does not say all 73 GWh were producing at once - treat as a floor, auditor may drop the 2023 step if D-021 forbids derived sums. The ~15 GWh super-factory phase 1 (Dec 2024) and the remaining ~52 GWh to reach 169 are not dated per phase in open sources, so no 2024 step. start_year left null: S7 says the base 'settled' (落户) in 2012 and that capacity started at 3 GWh, which is not a dated first-production statement. EVE annual reports 2021-2023 (filings dir) give no Jingmen cumulative capacity.

[T080] start_year 2022 (null -> 2022): CnEVPost 2022-12-20 (S8, citing Hubei Daily): first production line at the Xiangyang base went into operation on December 15 (2022), 1.9 GWh. Steps (design basis): 2022 = 1.9 (that one line, S8); 2025 = 30 (Yicai 2025-12-04, S9: phase 1 built, 30 GWh power-battery and parts project; same as T056 installed 30). No 2023 step: CnEVPost only says all 16 lines were EXPECTED by May 2023 (plan, 30 GWh) and I found no source confirming when the remaining lines started (two searches), so the ramp between Dec 2022 and Dec 2025 is undated. For series use: the 30 GWh was probably online well before 2025 but that is not sourced. The Yicai 30 GWh phrase bundles cells with parts (see T056 notes). Fetch-tool extraction used for S8; auditor please string-match.
